description: A chain: tool `a`; prompt `p` and tool `t`, both disabled by the profile; tool `after`, which renders `{{p.meta.disabled}}` and `{{t.value}}`; plus one enabled prompt `q`. Proves the skip-node shape and key order, a balanced start/end pair per disabled node, `effects_run`'s own count, that `after` sees the skip nodes, and -- via the absence of a `prime.p` entry in `scripted-replies.yaml` -- that no reply was consumed for the disabled prompt.
